rows.title: Wings of Desire review – Wim Wenders’ elegiac hymn to a broken cold-war Berlin | Movies
rows.dek_lead: Wim Wenders’ extravagantly wistful, intensely literary romantic fantasy, co-conceived with Peter Handke, is re-released and right now it looks more than anything like an elegiac “city symphony” about Berlin.
